description: Source code for wrg.c, a utility for fixing MD5 headers in WRG firmware images on MTD devices, including functions for header validation, MD5 checksum recalculation, and device memory operations.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRG header of a firmware image.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header in an MTD device at a specified offset, recalculating MD5 checksum and rewriting the block.
